In the upcoming college football game between North Dakota State and Hawai'i, originally scheduled for Saturday, November 14, 2026 at 11:00 PM ET (as of creation of the first market related to the event):
This market will resolve to "North Dakota State" if North Dakota State win the game.
This market will resolve to "Hawai'i" if Hawai'i win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If this market's outcome was definitively determined under its rules by the listed resolution sources before abandonment, that outcome will stand. Otherwise, the following no-result provisions apply. If the game is canceled, does not start by Monday, November 16, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or is abandoned with no official result by that time, this market will resolve 50-50.
